# has calendar method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCalendarMethod`](gmeow-hasCalendarMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCalendarMethod>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

Relates an email message to the iCalendar METHOD of the calendar component it carries. Non-functional: a message may theoretically carry multiple methods (though RFC 5546 recommends one per component).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EmailMessage`](../classes/gmeow-EmailMessage.md) -> [`gmeow:CalendarMethod`](../classes/gmeow-CalendarMethod.md)
